title: Mbengwi Council's 2026 budget: schools in Guneku among the projects discussed
excerpt: The Mbengwi Municipal Council's approved 2026 budget is 907,250,000 FCFA. A Fondom Studios report on the council's mid-term budget session names schools in Guneku among the projects discussed; what has been done for them is not yet established.
sourceNote: Written fresh on 17 October 2026 from the caption, on-screen titles and author comment of the Fondom Studios documentary published on Facebook on 24 September 2026. The 14-minute video's audio was not transcribed, so nothing is said here about which Guneku schools are concerned, what was asked for, or what has been completed.
body:
The approved 2026 budget of the Mbengwi Municipal Council, the council of the subdivision Guneku belongs to, is 907,250,000 FCFA. The figure comes from a Fondom Studios documentary on the council's 2026 mid-term budget orientation debate session, published on 24 September 2026.

What it says about Guneku

Among the projects and community needs the documentary lists as part of the council's development discussions are schools in Guneku — alongside schools in Njinibi, Mbemi and Chup, the Chaa Bridge, the Zang Tabi electricity project, roads for Gundom and Chenam, and water for Acha-Tugi. In the report's own words, some communities have completed projects, some have projects ongoing, and others are still waiting for their priorities to be addressed.

What is not yet established

The documentary's caption does not say which Guneku schools are meant, what work or funding is planned for them, or whether anything has been completed. Those details may be in the video itself, which has not been transcribed for this record. They will be added here when they are confirmed.

The caption also lists a bridge in Munam. Munam is one of Guneku's twenty-seven quarters, but the report does not say that this is the Munam it means, so no Guneku bridge project is recorded here.

Source

Fondom Studios, documentary report on the Mbengwi Municipal Council's 2026 budget, 24 September 2026. Watch it on Facebook.
